message.content: {"note_claim": "NATO's Article 5 refers to an armed attack against NATO members in Europe or North America, so an attack on a French base in the UAE would not be covered.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The Parties agree that an armed attack against one or more of them in Europe or North America shall be considered an attack against them all", "reason": "The page reproduces Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty verbatim, confirming the note's claim about the geographic limitation to Europe or North America, and Article 6 further restricts coverage to specified territories, excluding the UAE."}

parsed.note_claim: NATO's Article 5 refers to an armed attack against NATO members in Europe or North America, so an attack on a French base in the UAE would not be covered.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Parties agree that an armed attack against one or more of them in Europe or North America shall be considered an attack against them all
parsed.reason: The page reproduces Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty verbatim, confirming the note's claim about the geographic limitation to Europe or North America, and Article 6 further restricts coverage to specified territories, excluding the UAE.
